text: accentisuttaṃ [9] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti . [10] accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkhoti . pañcamaṃ
